answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a small copper bond that is slashed on proven fraud, so spawning ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand bonds. Verification is then split through a prism: no single authority grants standing; instead, independent facets, work history, peer endorsements, and dispute outcomes, must agree. Each endorsement is signed like a quill on a public record, and endorsers who vouch for fakes lose their own standing, so cheap identities stay cheap and trusted ones stay scarce.
